'''Chullka''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] spymaster living on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3640 BBY]] he was the oversser of a Gormak war party that assembled in the [[Gormak Lands]] beyond [[Outpost Skyline]] and began attacking convoys of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The Imperials put a bounty on his head, which resulted in the assault on the war party, in which Chullka was killed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Spymaster Chullka appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the mission "Gormak Sabotage" on Voss.
